verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no marketplace of ready-made scrapers that a developer can run directly. The only related item is a claim of "30+ ready-made templates" to start building from. That is a starter-code building block, not a runnable scraper marketplace, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
